subject: RE: Gam(m?)er Tags
author: drunknnumpty
body:
dude, not having a go, but its Gamertag.. also might have been worth putting a little more info into your post... which console (i know its a PSN ID on PS3 but you never know with some people).. which version of Burnout (Santa Ana, Revenge, Takedown??).. and maybe a little about yourself (what type of gamer, rec, pro, underg, type of racing/crash/rage etc)..  just putting your tag out there is not necessarily the right way to go about it..

 

also most of us on here have our tags in our profiles, so why not try messaging some of us when your online, you never know we may invite you into a room when we're on.. and ZombieTron is an ambassador for xbox (check her profile on live) and can give you advise about getting on with people online..

 

personally, happy for you to add my tag as a friend and if I'm on and burning (revenge mainly and paradise is a no at the moment) would be happy to race.. although best to get me on my abusedkarma tag at the moment as thats the one im burning with.. saving my rank as drunknnumpty as I have a nice one and a couple of free months worth of live subscriptions to play with...

 

theres a thin line between genius and insanity... i think i've fallen off...
